offence_note: Three common assaults and assault causing bodily harm on girlfriend
sentence_quote: It follows from this analysis that four years in prison was a fit sentence when it was imposed.
note: Ten-year firearms prohibition uncontested; fresh evidence of rehabilitation rejected as immaterial.

offence_note: Possession of fentanyl for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed and the sentence is reduced by 204 days.
note: 8-year sentence reduced by 204 days (1.5:1 credit for 136 days); other terms remain unstated.

sentence_quote: The sentence appeal is allowed and the appellant is awarded credit for 217 days served as part of his sentence.
note: Sentence length not shown; only enhanced credit of 217 days for 145 days of pre-trial custody on bail breach.

offence_note: Firearms offence with minimum 5 years and drug-related offences
sentence_quote: In our view the total sentence of 7 years was not demonstrably unfit in the circumstances.
note: 5 years on weapons count plus 2 years consecutive for drug offences.

offence_note: Armed robbery with loaded semi-automatic handgun
sentence_quote: an eight-year total sentence, less two years’ credit for pre-sentence custody, was well within the appropriate range
note: Sentence varied only by striking the victim fine surcharge.

offence_note: Trafficking cocaine, possession for trafficking, possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: sentenced to a term of 20 months’ imprisonment
note: 20 months given as months; racial profiling argument at arrest rejected; curfew reduced sentence by two weeks.

offence_note: Sexual assault of a friend, jury conviction
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal sentence and allow the appeal from sentence to the extent of reducing the victim surcharge from $4,000 to $100
note: Custodial term not shown; only the victim surcharge was reduced to $100.

offence_note: Offences not shown; new trial ordered on count 2
sentence_quote: allow the sentence appeal on all remaining counts and vary the sentences to time served
note: Conviction on count 2 set aside on consent; sentences on remaining counts varied to time served.

offence_note: Aggravated assault of fellow inmate in detention centre
co_offenders: Three co-accused were not sentenced in this decision
sentence_quote: vary the sentence to a term of two and one-half years imprisonment to be served consecutively to the appellant’s existing sentences
note: Illegal bifurcated 5-year sentence varied to 2.5 years consecutive; weapon counts set aside under Kienapple.

offence_note: Producing cannabis and possession for trafficking, over 3 kg
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a period of imprisonment for 18 months to be served in the community by way of a conditional sentence order
note: Conditional sentence with curfew; strata unit forfeited as offence-related property; 10-year firearms prohibition.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, threats, criminal harassment, breaches
sentence_quote: The seven-year term and ten-year LTSO are fit and there is no basis for this court to interfere with them.
note: Dangerous offender designation upheld; seven years plus ten-year long term supervision order.

offence_note: Firearm storage, prohibited weapon and device, breaches of recognizance
sentence_quote: On March 7, 2005, the learned trial judge imposed a global sentence of 90 days imprisonment composed of concurrent sentences of 90 days on count 6, 90 days on count 7
note: Global 90 days concurrent; 47 days pre-trial credit already factored in by sentencing judge.
